meta.conventions:
Generate data/buu/formulas.json and data/buu/rng.json (machine-readable formulas + lookup tables).

Every expression uses integer math exactly as the game does: '>>' arithmetic shift, '//' floor
division (C-style truncation noted where it matters), rand(n) = ((next()&0xFFFF)*n)>>16,
chance(p) = (next()&0xFFFF) < p. Units: HP/EP points unless stated; damage is produced in 1/1024 HP.
Python reference implementations live in re/buu/damage_model.py and re/buu/rng.py; both were checked
against the running game (verify_damage*.py: 48/48 exact; verify_levelup.py exact).

inputs.D: defender END (melee, obj+0x1B4) or END2 (energy, obj+0x1B6)

steps: melee only: crit = (sub != 3) and chance(82*S + crit_bonus); if crit: power = power + (power>>1)
if D >= 200: D = min(D/4 + 150, 220)             # C division (truncate)
if defender blocking (obj+0x1C8 != 0) and (hit.dir ^ 1) == defender.facing and dmg: dmg = (dmg * obj+0x1C0) >> 16   # 0x1000 -> 1/16
HP loss: acc += dmg; whole = acc >> 10; acc -= whole<<10; HP -= whole (player 0x08010BF2; enemies HP stored <<10, 0x0800FA2A)
damage.invulnerability: during the player hurt state (24 frames, VERIFIED emu) both resist bytes are 0 -> dmg 0
damage.status: VERIFIED: 48 game damage events (player melee/energy, crits, D>=200 clamp, enemy->player, frontal block) reproduced exactly from captured RNG state (verify_damage*.py)

crit.crit_bonus_from_equipment: percent * 656 (record+0x66, Charge Gloves 5, Shock Boots 10, Soccer Cleats 20)

xp.enemy_kill: gain = (enemy.exp * record[+0x58] + 255) >> 8, record+0x58 = 256 + sum(equipment exp bonuses); only the active character
xp.fusion: fusion forms (flag 0x04) pass the full amount to both component characters, then recompute fusion stats
xp.level: level = 50 + max{i in 0..150 : xp >= xp_table[i]}  (0x080135D2); xp_table at 0x086B7084 (levels.json)
xp.status: VERIFIED (disasm + emu: +1225 XP for a Majin Fighter, 1.0 multiplier)

level_up.function: 0x08013678 LevelUp(record, old, new); once per level gained
level_up.status: VERIFIED exactly (verify_levelup.py: predicted 135->153 HP, 90->99 EP for 60->62)

steps: calc = base STR/POW/END/END/SPD (record+0x28..0x2B; END copied into both END and END2)
for each of 4 equipped items: add s8 modifiers (+0x16..+0x1A), XP bonus (+0x1C) to calc+4, OR flags (+0x24) into record+0x13, run effect script (+0x28)
Holy Water (GameData+0x4DC != 0): add +0x4E0 STR, +0x4E4 POW, +0x4E8 END/END2, +0x4EC SPD (0x080046AE)
clamp negatives to 0 -> record+0x4C..+0x54; factors to +0x56..+0x67
stats_recalc.apply_to_player: 0x0800E074: obj STR/POW/END/END2 = record+0x4C..; resists = 128; walk = 5*SPD+102; dash = walk+320; crit bonus = record+0x66*656; block factor = record+0x60; thorns = record+0x5C

ss_gauge.fill: during the transform animation gauge = maxEP * frame/len (0x0801C4F4)
ss_gauge.drain: acc += 0xCCD per frame; every overflow (20 frames) gauge -= 1; at 0 -> revert (0x0800E3E6)
ss_gauge.energy_moves: use the SS gauge instead of EP while SS

forms.ss_cooldown: record+4 must be 0 to transform; it decreases by record+0x62>>6 per frame in normal form (0x08013E06); Super items x7/8
forms.status: stat/speed bonuses VERIFIED (emu, all 54 forms: measure_forms.py); gauge rules VERIFIED (disasm) + SS drain 3/s VERIFIED (emu)

regen.reserve_characters: same tick: every other party member EP += 5% maxEP and HP += 5% maxHP (0xCCD>>16)
regen.passive_HP: none, except record+0x64/256 HP per frame ("Z" Armor: 21/256)
regen.status: VERIFIED (disasm + emu: +2 EP (3% of 90) observed after ~600 frames idle)

knockback.enemy: ~15 px over 15 frames after a punch (emu); velocity = dir * ((rand(64)+96)*K)>>7 (0x08018A08, K from reaction def; x4 if obj+0x294)

zenie.loot_script_500: G=(level-48)*100; r=rand(400); 100Z if r<=G/100, 50Z if r<=G/83, 25Z if r<=G/66, else 5Z

loot.rolls: 1% chance of nothing; else d100 -> rolls 8 (<=5),7 (<=10),6 (<=20),5 (<=30),4 (<=40),3 (<=55),2 (<=75),1; +2 Lucky Charm (tested twice), +2 Rabbit's Foot, +3 Four-Leaf Clover, -1 Skull Ring, -2 Doom Amulet, -3 Hare's Foot; clamp 1..8
loot.forced_item: if forced_item set and chance(5%) and the player owns none: drop that equipment, uses one roll
loot.per_roll: if chance(85%) or (G2 and G1): zenie coin (script 500); elif not G1 and chance(25%): equipment roll (script 496, level-window tables; at most one equipment per kill via G1) - if it drops nothing it becomes a supply roll; else supply roll (script 499, at most one per kill via G2; later ones become zenie)
loot.quirk: G0..G3 are global words (0x03001058) shared with the sub-scripts: script 500 overwrites G1/G2 with non-zero values, so after the first zenie roll practically every remaining roll is also zenie. Items therefore almost only come from the first roll(s).
loot.simulation: enemies.json drops.simulated_per_kill (Monte-Carlo of the real bytecode, loot.py)
loot.pickup_rng_cost: spawning a pickup consumes RNG between rolls: coin 5 draws, equipment 4, supply 5 (assumed)
loot.status: VERIFIED: 500 kills match simulated rates (verify_loot.py); 60/60 kills replayed exactly (verify_loot2.py)

items.food: HP += value (+25% with Majestic Chopsticks equipped)
items.drink: EP += value (+25% with Twisty-Straw; bug sets HP instead)
